answer: Admission auction: each epoch only 40 entry slots are auctioned to newcomers. Bidders post a sealed price; the top 40 pay their bid as a sunk fee and enter. A gale of fake accounts cannot flood in, because every identity must outbid real demand. Minting 1,000 identities means winning 1,000 auctions: at 25 POA each, that is 25,000 POA burned. Honest agents pay one fee once and work in an oasis of verified peers, each on its own paid knoll.
